description: Three-model consensus review panel. Replaces the legacy independent reviewer-a/reviewer-b pair: every panelist reviews the full diff, they compare notes across rounds, and the job only advances when the panel broadly agrees.

panelists.focus: scientific and numerical correctness, mathematical assumptions, units/dimensions, tolerances, edge cases, and validation quality
code quality, build behavior, Kokkos/MPI/OpenMP/SYCL portability, memory layout, race/rank/backend risks, and maintainability
test adequacy, scope discipline, Git hygiene, and whether the documented behavior matches the actual diff
